subject: StormForge onboarding: PO issuance request — spend cap mismatch & line-item reclassification
messages:
From: Lina Morales <lina@stormforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Completed onboarding docs + spend cap discrepancy

Hi Karthik,

Attached are the completed onboarding form and our W-9. Our finance team flagged that the spend cap in Redwood’s procurement intake (50,000 USD) doesn’t match the SOW we executed with your sales team (75,000 USD). We need a PO that reflects the SOW so we can start provisioning billing.

Attachments: onboarding-form-20261103.xlsx, StormForge_W9.pdf

Can you confirm the PO number and expected timeline? If you need an internal contact on our side for approvals, loop in Lina Morales (me) or finance@stormforge.com.

Thanks — Lina
Lina Morales
Director of Partnerships, StormForge
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Morales <lina@stormforge.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Completed onboarding docs + spend cap discrepancy

Kimberly / Monica — forwarding onboarding docs from StormForge (attached). Customer says SOW is for 75k but intake landed them on a 50k spend cap. They need a PO that matches the SOW to get finance looped and billing started.

What I need from procurement:
- Confirm whether we can issue a PO at the 75k amount or if a spend-cap exception is required and how long approval takes.
- If we can proceed, please issue the PO and include a two-line split: Cloud Compute and Premier Support (customer prefers line-level mapping).

Links: Jira PROC-9874 (intake ticket) and onboarding folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/StormForge-Onboard

Attaching onboarding-form-20261103.xlsx and W-9. Lina — thanks for sending this over. I’ll share procurement ETA once I hear back.

—Karthik
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Morales <lina@stormforge.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Completed onboarding docs + spend cap discrepancy

Thanks for the ping. Quick summary from procurement side after reviewing the onboarding packet and the SOW: the intake form defaulted to our standard onboarding tier ($50,000) because the intake checkbox for "SOW-backed spend" wasn't flagged. That explains the discrepancy.

Options and recommended next steps:
1) Issue a spend-cap exception to match the SOW (75,000 USD). This requires procurement manager + finance director approval. Timeline: 24–48 business hours if approvals are obtained today.

2) If approvals will be slower, we can issue a provisional PO for 50k immediately and follow with a PO amendment once exception is approved — but the customer requested the PO to match the SOW to avoid a separate amendment.

Line-item suggestion (per customer preference):
- Cloud Compute — $60,000
- Premier Support — $15,000

I attached a small spreadsheet with the proposed line-item split (proposed-line-split-20261108.xlsx). To move forward I need:
- Karthik: confirmation that the dollar split above maps to the SOW (yes/no).
- Monica/Finance: approval for a $75k spend-cap exception or confirmation to proceed with provisional 50k PO.

Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lina Morales <lina@stormforge.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: PO issued: PO-2026-1184 (StormForge) — spend cap exception approved

Update — procurement has approved the spend-cap exception. Per approvals from Finance Director (email chain logged under Jira PROC-9874), I issued a PO that reflects the SOW and the requested line split.

Details: PO number: PO-2026-1184
Total: $75,000
Lines:
- Cloud Compute | Qty 1 | $60,000
- Premier Support | Qty 1 | $15,000

Attachments: PO-2026-1184.pdf (formal PO), proposed-line-split-20261108.xlsx (finalized).

Next steps for the customer:
- Lina: confirm receipt and that line mapping meets StormForge billing requirements.
- Karthik: pass PO PDF to the customer and confirm start-of-billing date.

If anything needs amending we can process a minor change request; otherwise this should clear finance for provisioning.

Thanks — Kimberly
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
